title: EchoForge pinned artifact manifest
description: Every model and inference runtime EchoForge is allowed to download. Nothing outside this file may be fetched, and every entry must name an immutable revision. A branch name or a mutable model alias is a build failure, not a warning.

artifact_id.description: EchoForge's stable internal name, e.g. stt.large-v3-turbo.

kind.description: What sort of artifact this is.

repository.description: The project this artifact comes from: a source repository or a package index project page. Identity, not a fetch location.

url.description: The exact immutable HTTPS URL this one file is fetched from, pinned to the revision above. The downloader reads this and nothing else: an URL that lives anywhere other than this manifest is outside the gate.

revision.description: Full immutable commit SHA or release tag. Never main, master, latest, or an alias. Spelled out as character classes because JSON Schema patterns are ECMA-262 and have no inline (?i) flag: written with one, this guard silently fails to compile instead of rejecting anything.

filename.description: Exact file to fetch. Never a directory or a glob.

size_bytes.description: Expected byte length, checked before hashing.

sha256.description: Expected digest of the complete file, lower-case hex.

license_file.description: Repository-relative path of the retained license or NOTICE text.

provenance.description: Where this artifact came from and who published it, when the repository alone is ambiguous.

runtime_version.description: The runtime build this artifact was verified against.

profiles.description: Processing profiles this artifact is compatible with.

verified_utc.description: When this entry was last checked against its source.
